title: Representative Fees on Compensation Releases in the Veterans Pension Benefit Income Statement
content:
# Accredited representative's fee — Veterans Pension benefit income statement

An accredited representative's fee withheld from a retroactive Disability Compensation release under a direct-pay fee agreement is not the veteran's income. In the veteran's benefit income statement on his Veterans Pension award, the fee is taken out of the retroactive releases issued to him according to the fee agreement recorded on his Disability Compensation award and the fee withheld shown on those releases in the compensation payment ledger:

| Direct-pay fee agreement on file | Fee withheld compared with 20 percent of the release | Taken out of the release |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | no more than 20 percent | the whole fee withheld |
| Yes | more than 20 percent | 20 percent of the release, rounded to the cent |
| No | — | nothing |

Here "the release" is the gross amount of the retroactive compensation releases issued to the veteran, and the fee withheld is the total withheld from them. The amount taken out is not counted as the veteran's income.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical release of 10000.00 gross; 20 percent is 2000.00)

| Agreement | Fee withheld | Taken out |
|---|---|---|
| on file | 2000.00 | 2000.00 — exactly at 20 percent, the whole fee |
| on file | 2000.01 | 2000.00 — capped at 20 percent of the release |
| on file | 1500.00 | 1500.00 |
| none on file | 1500.00 | 0 |
